RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel chose a male candidate over you, also male. Sex can't plausibly explain why you lost to him — you share the characteristic. Raising the panel's composition would read as grasping and would undercut the parts of your case that are actually strong.

What's strong: a near-doubling of design experience, equivalent licensure, and three major projects led, against a stated rationale resting on "excellent client relationships" — a vague, subjective criterion. That's the ground to press. Age is the only protected characteristic with any conceivable traction (you're older, he's less experienced), but on these facts it's thin.

Send a firm follow-up citing your two-week-old request, ask for the scoring matrix and criteria weightings, and note any internal deadline for feedback.
